PNG sanitation integrity recheck
================================

Reason
------
The sanitized ZIP was smaller than the uploaded original, so the runtime tree, exports, tests, and byte-level behavior were re-audited.

Package-size finding
--------------------
Original ZIP: 185 KiB-class archive.
Sanitized ZIP: 125 KiB-class archive before this recheck.
The original package contains non-runtime development material that was intentionally not copied: fuzz harness/corpus infrastructure, CI scripts, differential-libpng harness, legacy reports, and a 118 KiB test_upgrade.c.

For the 14 common runtime C/H files:
  original bytes: 512784
  sanitized common-file bytes: 520379
Sanitized-only png_mem89/png_fixed89 support adds 17232 bytes.
Therefore sanitized runtime source is 24827 bytes LARGER than the original runtime source set.

Export audit
------------
Original global symbols: 143
Sanitized global symbols: 161
Missing original symbols in sanitized build: 0
New symbols: 18 (png_mem89 + png_fixed89 helpers)

Decoder before/after regression
-------------------------------
PNG comparisons: 76 total
  matching successful outputs: 66
  matching malformed/error results: 10
  mismatches: 0

APNG comparisons: 7 total
  matching successful frame dumps: 3
  matching malformed/error results: 4
  mismatches: 0

Original functional-suite migration
-----------------------------------
The original test_upgrade.c contains 38 functional tests. Its floating-point metadata literals/output variables were mechanically migrated to png_fixed89 values so it could exercise the sanitized public ABI without mixing old/new struct layouts.
Result: ALL_TESTS_OK (38/38).

Sanitizer recheck
-----------------
The first sanitation pass had a real allocator alignment bug: blocks were rounded only to four bytes. UBSan detected misaligned png_decoder access on a 64-bit validation host.
Fix: arena base alignment is forced with a C89 union and block/header boundaries are rounded to the maximum target data-pointer/function-pointer/unsigned-int size.
After fix: migrated 38-test suite -> ALL_TESTS_OK under AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.

Protocol audit after fix
------------------------
No runtime calls to malloc/calloc/realloc/free.
No float/double runtime types.
No long long/int64_t/uint64_t runtime types.
No LP64-sensitive long/size_t declarations in codec-owned runtime sources.
zlib allocator callbacks remain arena-backed.

Encoder byte-equivalence caveat
--------------------------------
Representative encoder output without real-valued metadata is byte-identical between original and sanitized builds, including Adam7.
When authoring gAMA/cHRM through Q16.16, whole-file bytes can differ slightly because Q16.16 cannot exactly represent every five-decimal metadata value. This does not affect the verified byte-identical decoded pixel/frame outputs, but exact metadata-file roundtrip is not claimed.
